With the remote control, you can switch them on or off from up to 25 m away, dim them in four stages from 25 to 100 percent, and choose between three lighting modes; alternatively, you can control them via the app. The string lights run on 24 V and are protected against splashing water to IP44.

You can choose from 8 lighting modes, and thanks to the cord, you can place the panel where it gets the sun. A ground stake with connector is included.
